calls.statement: SELECT channel_code, channel_id, staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), sum(gross_amount) g, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-07-25' AND '2024-10-05' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, s.region, s.store_id>=900 AS pseudo, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) d, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dl, sum(f.gross_amount) g, sum(f.net_amount) nt,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - round(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) badgross,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) badver,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date <> CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) datediff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT vat_rate, count(*), sum(net_amount), sum(gross_amount), min(quantity), max(quantity), sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, sum(CASE WHEN gross_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullg FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT vat_rate, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(*), sum(CASE WHEN sale_date<'2024-09-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) aug, sum(CASE WHEN sale_date>='2024-09-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sep FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT channel_code, sum(CASE WHEN sale_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) match_local, sum(CASE WHEN sale_date = CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) match_utc, count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT region,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN sale_date < '2024-09-01' THEN gross_amount END),2) AS aug_2024,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN sale_date >= '2024-09-01' THEN gross_amount END),2) AS sep_2024,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30') AS total_lines,
 (SELECT sum(gross_amount) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30') AS total_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id <> 999
GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
